title: Adversarial review
description: Review a branch or PR with several models in the background, then start one session to verify and address the findings

settings.label: Reviewer model
settings.description: Used for the reviewers when the repo has its own review guidance (one reviewer), and for the address-review session.

settings.label: Reviewers file

settings.label: Reports folder
settings.description: Where finished review reports are written.
